```{=html}
<!-- ── Navbar ─────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
{{< include _navbar.html >}}

<!-- ── Page content ───────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="auth-page">
  <div class="auth-card">
    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-logo">
    <h2>Student Log In</h2>
    <p class="auth-subtitle">Enter your username to continue</p>
    <div id="errorMsg" class="auth-error" style="display:none;"></div>
    <form id="studentLoginForm" onsubmit="return false;">
      <label for="username">Username</label>
      <input type="text" id="username" placeholder="Enter your username" required>
      <button type="submit" class="auth-btn" id="loginBtn">Log In</button>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>


<script>
document.getElementById('studentLoginForm').addEventListener('submit', async () => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
  const errorMsg = document.getElementById('errorMsg');
  const username = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();

  if (!username) return;

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Logging in...';
  errorMsg.style.display = 'none';

  try {
    const res = await fetch(EDGE_FUNCTION_URL + '/student-login', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + SUPABASE_ANON_KEY },
      body: JSON.stringify({ username })
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Login failed');

    const { error } = await _supabase.auth.setSession({
      access_token: data.session.access_token,
      refresh_token: data.session.refresh_token
    });
    if (error) throw error;

    window.location.href = 'student-hub.html';
  } catch (err) {
    errorMsg.textContent = err.message;
    errorMsg.style.display = 'block';
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Log In';
  }
});
</script>
<script>
function toggleMenu() {
  document.getElementById('navbarLinks').classList.toggle('show');
}
</script>
```
